content.title: Synthetic Research Workflow Poster
content.subtitle: A layered Photoshop JSX starter using fictional content and placeholder visuals.
content.authors: Alex Smith, Mina Rivera, Jordan Lee

sections.heading: Motivation
sections.body: Public poster templates should be editable, layered, and safe to share without exposing private data.

sections.heading: Workflow
sections.body: Generate layer groups, section panels, figure placeholders, and export previews from a repeatable script.

sections.heading: Checks
sections.body: Review typography, figure placement, color contrast, captions, QR code targets, and final export settings.

sections.heading: Takeaway
sections.body: Keep automation generic. Put real research content only in private project copies.
